text: Guys, today I want to continue talking about men's main rules, principles that should guide you if you want to live a calm, confident, and solid life as a man. And today's rule is incredibly important. It is, simplify, don't complicate. Especially when it comes to dating and relationships. Here's the truth, the overwhelming majority of best dating stories start smooth. She replies to your text, you invite her out, she says yes, you meet, you both have fun, the vibe is natural, no drama, no chasing, no convincing her. Now compare that to when it's tough from the start. She replies once every two days, cancels plans, always busy, and you keep thinking, if I just try harder, she will come around. News flash, she won't. Those situations almost never go anywhere. That's why you should focus on the interactions that are fun and easygoing, where her interest and energy match yours from the start. I know, movies, books, and songs will tell you the opposite. They glorify the man who fights for her heart, wins her over, proves he is worthy. But that is fiction. Real life is different. In real life, attractions should be mutual from the start, not a competition you have to win. So stop complicating. If it's heavy and hard from the beginning, let it go. Simplify, don't complicate. Put your energy into connections that feel natural, not forced. If you want to watch other Men's Main Rules videos, the easiest way to find them is to go to my new YouTube channel via link in the bio and look for the corresponding playlist. There I am also posting some unique content, so I would appreciate if you subscribe. That is it for now. My name is Ilyas Abdullin. Thanks for watching.
